title: Premium subscription and Collection
description: How Premium unlocks tracks, articles, stems, and downloads from artists in your collection.

blocks.content: Listeners can subscribe to **Premium** to add artists to their **Collection**. Artists in your collection unlock exclusive content across the platform: locked tracks, articles, stems, and album downloads.

blocks.subtitle: Plans
content: Premium plans differ by how many artist slots your collection can hold (Explorer, Collector, Archivist tiers).
Subscription is billed through YooKassa on the platform checkout page.
Revenue from subscriptions is distributed equally among supported artists.

blocks.subtitle: Add an artist to your collection
content: Open an artist page and choose **Add to collection** when content is locked.
Select a Premium plan if you are not subscribed yet.
After payment, add the artist to an available slot in **Dashboard → Collection**.

blocks.subtitle: Manage subscription
content: Open **Dashboard → Settings** to view your account.
Collection slots and active artists are managed under **Dashboard → Collection**.
